title: Late-week South Florida nightlife guide
igCaption:
Late-week plans across South Florida, from Hollywood to Boca to downtown Miami.

Sources: Ticketmaster, Sun Sentinel, The Boca Raton Tribune, Secret Miami, Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood Poker

scenes.text: Boca has November food plans on deck. The Sun Sentinel roundup included the Beer B Que Music Festival, the Savor Boca Experience, and Galbani Feast of Little Italy. The Boca Raton Tribune also flagged the Red Meat Lovers Club fall 2026 event series. At Boca’s food events, open NEAR and see who’s at your table.
